auth.title: Keep your comparisons
auth.description: Sign in to keep data across devices and beyond the guest retention window.
auth.guestBanner: You’re browsing as a guest. Sign in to keep comparisons across devices and longer than two weeks.
auth.magicLinkSent: Check your email for a sign-in link.
auth.verifyFailedBody: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one from the app.
auth.errorBody: Something went wrong while signing in. Try again from the app.
auth.oauthUnavailable: Google sign-in is not configured on this server.

home.title: Home
home.emptyDescription: Create a comparison to add criteria, entries, and start ranking.

pages.entriesBlurb: Entries are the items you compare against your criteria.
pages.criteriaBlurb: Criteria identify an entry or let you compare entries.
pages.rulesBlurb: Rules define how comparable criteria affect ranking and how much each counts.
pages.resultsBlurb: Results rank entries by weighted rules. Best match is at the top.

createComparison.title: New comparison
createComparison.description: Give your comparison a name to get started.

createCriterion.title: New criterion
createCriterion.description: Criteria describe how entries are named and compared.

createEntry.title: New entry
createEntry.description: Name is required. Other criterion values can be filled in later.

comparisonActions.renameDescription: Only the display name changes; criteria and entries stay the same.
comparisonActions.deleteDescription: This permanently deletes the comparison and all its criteria and entries. Type <name>{comparisonName}</name> to confirm.

criterionActions.renameDescription: Type and config stay the same; only the display name changes.
criterionActions.deleteDescription: This permanently deletes <name>{criterionName}</name> and all values stored for it on entries.

entryActions.editDescription: Update criterion values for this entry. Clearing an optional value removes it.
entryActions.deleteDescription: This permanently deletes <name>{label}</name> and all of its criterion values.

enumRule.title: Edit rule · {name}
enumRule.description: Drag options into tiers. Tier 1 is best; the last tier is worst. Save when every option is assigned exactly once.

weightQuestionnaire.title: Distribute weights
weightQuestionnaire.introDescription: You will answer short preference questions about your comparable criteria. Each question asks which criterion matters more, or whether both matter equally.
weightQuestionnaire.maxQuestions: {count, plural, one {There will be at most # question.} other {There will be at most # questions.}}
weightQuestionnaire.replaceNote: Your current weights will be replaced when you finish.
weightQuestionnaire.question: What is more important to you?
weightQuestionnaire.questionHint: Choose one criterion, or both if they matter equally.
weightQuestionnaire.undecided: {count, plural, one {# undecided comparison} other {# undecided comparisons}}

configAlert.weightsZero: No weights assigned — all scores are equal.
configAlert.rulesUnset: Some ranking rules aren’t set yet.
configAlert.valuesMissing: Some entry values are missing — incomplete data may distort ranking.
